youtube.title: Which is the longest living animal? One was born before the USA existed 🦈
youtube.description:
Bowhead whale, giant tortoise or the third one? One of these can live about four centuries, is not an adult until around 150, and scientists worked out its age by reading the lens of its eye.
Guess before the map lights up, then see the age table, how slowly it grows, and the date it may have been born.
Which did you pick?
